_why: A component name in two families makes every by-name lookup resolve to whichever entry it meets first. Two were found on 2026-09-21. One was a mistake and is FIXED in the library (the tight-cut overlays were listed under the transitions' names). One is REAL and needs a rename decision, so it is described here with its consequence rather than skipped quietly — a checker that carries its own exceptions hides them.
_rule: The check FAILS on any collision not listed here. An entry is a decision on the record with a date and an owner, never a way to make the check green.

collisions.name: StickyNotes
collisions.state: REAL — two different components, one name
collisions.evidence: ported_mg/StickyNotes.jsx is 16336 bytes and takes notes: StickyNote[]; port/bodies/StickyNotes.jsx is 5443 bytes and is the text-overlay variant. Different shas, different property shapes, both built.
collisions.consequence: Any by-name lookup — the inventory line, the inventory picture, the platter — resolves to one of them arbitrarily. Neither is wrong to exist; the NAME is.
collisions.owner: Zac — a rename is a product decision, not a port decision
